S_zero: The total interval excludes no difference: a3r exceeded attention on yeast complexes (preregistered exploratory estimation; not a confirmatory test).
S_min: The whole interval lies above the smallest effect of interest (+0.005).
S_ecoli: The whole interval lies above the E. coli estimate (+0.027).
S_fixed: Exploratory estimation, not a confirmatory test, a replication or a validation. a3r is not adopted; this study cannot change that by itself (PI decisions 12 and 13 Nov).
claim: VALIDATION RUN on consumed data, not a claim: tcaCLR exceeds aCLR in pooled co-membership AUPR on the consumed truth; the gain is carried by complexes of 20 or more genes; the E. coli preregistered test of the same readout did not meet the one-sided 0.025 threshold (M3D p = 0.079, EcoMAC p = 0.051).
breadth_sentence: The pooled gain is carried by 4 complexes; tcaCLR did not improve the median complex.
h2_sentence: H2: the prediction held (large positive, mid near zero, small not positive).
